pages.title: General
pages.desc: How far you see, brightness and presets.

items.title: Preset
items.desc: Picks settings for your phone. Changing any of them switches to Custom.

items.title: Render distance
items.desc: How far around you the world is drawn.

items.title: Far detail distance
items.desc: Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for GPUs it slows down. 0 = off.

items.title: Simulation distance
items.desc: How far mobs, crops and machines keep working. CPU time.

items.title: Brightness
items.desc: Brightens dark places.

pages.title: Display
pages.desc: Screen orientation, aspect ratio, camera cutout and safe zones.

items.title: GUI scale
items.desc: Size of menus and the HUD.

items.title: Fullscreen
items.desc: Fills the screen (borderless).

items.title: VSync
items.desc: Locks frames to the screen's refresh rate.

items.title: FPS limit
items.desc: Caps frames per second; a cap saves power and heat.

items.title: Reduce FPS when
items.desc: Lowers the frame rate when minimised, or idle too.

items.title: Menu background blur
items.desc: Blurs the world behind menus.

items.title: Attack indicator
items.desc: Shows attack cooldown.

items.title: Autosave indicator
items.desc: Shows when the world saves.

items.title: Orientation
items.desc: Choose which screen orientations the game may use.

items.title: Aspect ratio
items.desc: Fit the game to an aspect ratio within the display.

items.title: HUD safe zone (sides)
items.desc: Move the HUD inward from the left and right edges.

items.title: HUD safe zone (top/bottom)
items.desc: Move the HUD inward from the top and bottom edges.

items.title: Interface safe zone (sides)
items.desc: Move menus inward from the left and right edges.

items.title: Draw under camera cutout
items.desc: Uses the notch area for the picture.

pages.title: Quality
pages.desc: The sky and weather, lighting, textures and the image.

items.title: Clouds
items.desc: Cloud layer: off, flat (fast) or 3D (fancy).

items.title: Cloud range
items.desc: How far clouds reach, in chunks.

items.title: Sky
items.desc: Draws the sky, sun, moon and stars.

items.title: Fog
items.desc: Distance fog. Off shows the edge of the loaded world.

items.title: Weather
items.desc: Draws rain and snow.

items.title: Weather range
items.desc: How far rain and snow fall around you.

items.title: Particles
items.desc: How many particles effects spawn.

items.title: Smooth lighting
items.desc: Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk building time only.

items.title: Entity distance
items.desc: How far away mobs and items are drawn, as a share of normal.

items.title: Entity shadows
items.desc: Round shadows under mobs and items.

items.title: Vignette
items.desc: Darkens the screen's edges.

items.title: Chunk fade-in
items.desc: Fades newly loaded chunks in.

items.title: Mipmap levels
items.desc: Smoother distant textures.

items.title: Leaves
items.desc: Leaves with see-through gaps. Off draws them solid.

items.title: Exact transparency sorting
items.desc: Sorts water and glass more exactly behind each other.

items.title: Animated textures
items.desc: Animates water, lava, fire and other moving textures.

items.title: Dither cutout mipmaps
items.desc: Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from fading far away.

items.title: Resolution
items.desc: Renders below native and scales up. Lower is faster.

items.title: Dynamic resolution
items.desc: Changes resolution to keep the frame rate below.

items.title: Dynamic resolution target
items.desc: The frame rate Dynamic Resolution keeps.

items.title: FXAA
items.desc: Fast edge smoothing.

items.title: TAA
items.desc: Temporal anti-aliasing. Smoother, can soften the picture.

items.title: Upscaling
items.desc: Renders lower and upscales.

items.title: Upscaling sharpness
items.desc: Sharpening after upscaling.

items.title: Frame generation
items.desc: AMD FidelityFX frame interpolation.

items.title: Screenshot quality
items.desc: JPEG quality for screenshots.

pages.title: Performance
pages.desc: Chunk loading, culling and power use.

items.title: Chunk updates per frame
items.desc: How many chunk meshes may rebuild each frame.

items.title: Upload budget
items.desc: Chunk data sent to the GPU per frame.

items.title: Texture budget
items.desc: Texture memory the game may use.

items.title: Worker threads
items.desc: Threads that generate, light and mesh chunks. Next start.

items.title: Parallel tick
items.desc: Ticks mobs and blocks on several threads.

items.title: Cave culling
items.desc: Skips terrain hidden behind closed sections. Off costs a lot.

items.title: GPU culling
items.desc: Culls on the GPU.

items.title: Entity culling
items.desc: Hides entities behind opaque blocks.

items.title: Particle culling
items.desc: Skips particles out of view.

items.title: Leaf culling
items.desc: Hides inner leaf faces.

items.title: Opaque ice
items.desc: Draws ice in the solid pass, without its see-through texture.

items.title: Cache shulker boxes
items.desc: Reuses settled boxes; lid movement stays animated.

items.title: Cache signs
items.desc: Reuses sign text until text, light, or font changes.

items.title: Cache decorated pots
items.desc: Reuses still pots; break wobble and sherd changes redraw.

items.title: Cache bells
items.desc: Reuses still bells; ringing stays animated.

items.title: Cache chests
items.desc: Reuses closed chests; moving lids stay animated.

items.title: Cache banners
items.desc: Reuses poles; flags and pattern layers still update.

items.title: Cache copper golem statues
items.desc: Reuses statue geometry until its block state changes.

items.title: Battery saver
items.desc: Lower power draw while playing.

items.title: Shadow cache
items.desc: Reuses shadow maps between frames.

pages.title: Shader packs
pages.desc: Shader packs, Starling Visuals and their options.

items.title: Shader pack
items.desc: Put packs in Starling/shaderpacks.

items.title: Profile
items.desc: Auto fits the pack to the phone.

items.title: Shader resolution
items.desc: Lower is faster with shaders.

items.title: Shader FPS limit
items.desc: FPS cap while a pack runs.

items.title: Open shader pack folder
items.desc: Opens the folder in your file manager.

pages.title: Advanced
pages.desc: How frames reach the screen, and the performance overlay.

items.title: Graphics API
items.desc: Auto picks Vulkan, then OpenGL.

items.title: Present mode
items.desc: How frames reach the screen while VSync is off.

items.title: Frame pacing
items.desc: Evens out frame times.

items.title: Performance overlay
items.desc: Frame rate and frame times over the game, with a graph.

pages.title: HDR
pages.desc: Brighter-than-white output on an HDR display.

items.title: HDR
items.desc: Brighter-than-white output on an HDR display.

items.title: Paper white
items.desc: How bright white is.

items.title: Peak brightness
items.desc: The display's brightest point.

items.title: Black level
items.desc: Raises the darkest value.

items.title: HUD brightness
items.desc: How bright the HUD and menus are. Auto: at paper white.

items.title: HDR lighting
items.desc: Linear-light lighting for HDR.

items.title: Smooth gradients
items.desc: Dithers HDR gradients.

pages.title: Extras
pages.desc: Optional conveniences. Every one is off by default.

items.title: Fullbright
items.desc: Displays blocks and entities fully bright, including in caves.

items.title: Dynamic lights
items.desc: Held torches, lava buckets and burning mobs light their surroundings.

items.title: Show own name tag
items.desc: Draws your name tag in third person.

items.title: Hide block-break particles
items.desc: Skips the particles when a block breaks.

items.title: Auto-reconnect
items.desc: Rejoins the server after a dropped connection.

items.title: Mouse Tweaks controls
items.desc: Drag-split and drag-move stacks in inventories.

items.title: Inventory sorting
items.desc: Adds sort buttons to inventories.

items.title: Smooth chat
items.desc: Animates chat messages in.

items.title: Chunk pregeneration
items.desc: Makes /pregen available in single-player and LAN worlds.

pages.title: Controls
pages.desc: Amethyst touch controls, gestures, virtual mouse, gyroscope and controller.

items.title: Edit controls
items.desc: Open the Amethyst custom controls editor.

items.title: Disable gestures
items.desc: Disables gestures, such as hold to break block, and tap to place a block.

items.title: Disable double tap to swap hands
items.desc: Disables double tapping on the hotbar item to swap it in the second hand.

items.title: Trigger long press delay
items.desc: How long to hold before a press becomes break/attack.

items.title: Control buttons scaling
items.desc: Scales every on-screen control.

items.title: Only use capital letters in button labels
items.desc: Shows button labels in upper case.

items.title: Keyboard panning
items.desc: Pans the game when the keyboard is open.

items.title: Mouse scaling
items.desc: Size of the virtual cursor.

items.title: Mouse speed
items.desc: How fast the virtual cursor and camera move.

items.title: Start with virtual mouse on
items.desc: The virtual mouse appears at startup when this option is on.

items.title: Use virtual cursor
items.desc: Show the virtual cursor when the game releases the mouse.

items.title: Enable gyroscope
items.desc: Aim by turning the phone.

items.title: Gyroscope controls sensitivity
items.desc: Adjust the sensitivity of gyroscope controls.

items.title: Gyroscope sampling rate
items.desc: If you have performance issues with gyroscope controls, increase this.

items.title: Enable gyroscope smoothing
items.desc: Reduce jitter in exchange of latency.

items.title: Invert X axis
items.desc: Invert the horizontal axis.

items.title: Invert Y axis
items.desc: Invert the vertical axis.

items.title: Remap controller
items.desc: Change which controller button does what.

items.title: Reset controller mappings
items.desc: Back to the default controller mappings.

items.title: Controller deadzone scale
items.desc: How far a stick must move before it counts.

items.title: Force SDL gamepad
items.desc: Use SDL's gamepad mapping for controllers.

items.title: Force-enable TouchController
items.desc: Enables the TouchController mod's input.

items.title: Vibration length
items.desc: How long the phone buzzes on a control press. 0 = off.

items.title: Skin model
items.desc: Arm width of your skin.

items.title: Choose skin PNG
items.desc: From your files or Starling/skins.

items.desc: Native mod. Install, then Compile.

items.title: Keystrokes
items.desc: Native mod. Install, then Compile.

items.title: Zoom
items.desc: Native mod. Install, then Compile.

items.title: Open pack folder
items.desc: Resource packs, shader packs, mods and worlds.

pages.title: Diagnostics & files
pages.desc: Stats overlay, crash reports, updates and storage.

items.title: Stats overlay
items.desc: FPS, memory and temperature.

items.title: Record CPU/GPU performance
items.desc: Optional recording for bug reports.

items.title: Export diagnostic ZIP
items.desc: Review it, then share it with a bug report.

items.title: Check for updates
items.desc: Starling updates are installed by the game itself.

items.title: Reset Starling settings
items.desc: Back to the defaults for this device.
